table.purpose: Master list of customers from an earlier system: code, name, status, city, registration date, phone and a credit amount.
assumptions: 'mst' in the table name suggests master data; the columns describe a person or account.
unknowns: Which current table these customers were migrated to.
Why 1% of rows share the date 2019-01-01 (possibly a default for unknown dates).

columns.name: c01
columns.purpose: Unique code identifying the customer in the legacy system.

value_domain.description: A letter followed by eight digits; unique.

example_questions: Find the legacy customer with code C00012345.
assumptions: The table is a customer master, so its unique code identifies the customer.
unknowns: Whether the code is reused in other tables.

alternatives.purpose: Identifier of a billing account rather than a person.

columns.name: c02
columns.purpose: Full name of the customer in upper case.

value_domain.description: Two upper-case words (first and last name).

example_questions: How many legacy customers are called the same?
assumptions: The two-word upper-case shape is a first and last name.
unknowns: 1.5k distinct names for 18k rows (8%) is low for people; names may repeat or be shortened.

columns.name: c03
columns.purpose: Whether the customer is active (Y) or not (N).
example_questions: What share of legacy customers is active?
unknowns: What Y means exactly: active, approved or consented.

alternatives.purpose: Whether the customer agreed to be contacted.

columns.name: c04
columns.purpose: City of the customer, in upper case.
example_questions: How many legacy customers live in each city?
unknowns: Whether it is the home or billing city.

columns.name: c05
columns.purpose: Date the customer was registered, as a yyyymmdd number.
example_questions: How many customers registered per year?
unknowns: The 1% at 2019-01-01 may be a placeholder.

columns.name: c06
columns.purpose: Customer phone number with country code, digits only.
example_questions: How many legacy customers have a phone number?
unknowns: Whether it is a mobile or landline number.

columns.name: c07
columns.purpose: Credit limit granted to the customer, stored as text; 10% are empty strings.
example_questions: What is the total credit extended to legacy customers?
assumptions: Empty means no limit was set.
unknowns: Whether it is a limit, a balance or a tier.

alternatives.purpose: A tier label that happens to be an amount.
